notes: StockByLocationPage.tsx applies className="qty-right" which is not defined in theme.css and has no corresponding CSS custom property -- it is an ad-hoc style outside the design-token system (violates the typography/spacing token adherence rubric). The Driver should either add a `.qty-right { text-align: right; }` rule anchored to a token (e.g. using `var(--space-2)` for padding) in theme.css, or replace the class with an inline `style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}` scoped to a token-backed utility.
